text:
Maya (Growth): heads-up — planning a small launch for the HackWeek Guides: a 4-part OSS tutorial + 1 benchmarking deep dive + a kickoff webinar. want to align on messaging and inbound routing before next monday. deck: https://tiny.redwood/hackweek-deck :spiral_calendar:
Jon (DevRel): love it. can we make the first tutorial a 'get-started with local inference' walkthru? fast win for devs.
Lina (PMM): +1. suggested headline: 'Ship local LLM features in a day — a hands-on HackWeek guide'. keeps it practical.
Samir (Product): benchmark piece should show latency/cost tradeoffs across 3 configs. we can use the dedicated profiles from last quarter. goal: one clear takeaway for each audience (startup, mid-market, infra).
Kai (Analytics): for inbound routing, let's add an early gating form to capture company size + infra preference, then route to self-serve emails vs. sales via zapier. I'll draft the UTM and lead mapping. example UTM: ?utm_source=hackweek&utm_campaign=guides_launch&utm_medium=social
Maya (Growth): timeline proposal: draft landing copy by Thu, tutorial drafts Fri, video recordings Mon-Tue next week, webinar Wed. Is that realistic?
Jon (DevRel): I can record 2 short vids (setup + advanced tweaks). Lina — can you own the landing copy?
Lina (PMM): yep I can. will aim for Thurs morning. also propose 2 CTAs: 'Start self-serve' and 'Request dedicated trial' so we feed both funnels.
Samir (Product): for benchmark narrative, suggest 3 callouts: median latency, cost per 1k tokens, and graceful fallback behavior. will write short blurb tying to Redwood Optimize.
Kai (Analytics): routing rules: if company_size = "enterprise" OR infra = "private" -> sales; otherwise -> nurture drip (3 emails) + demo invite. I can share the Zapier mapping later.
dev-rel-bot: Reminder: asset checklist due in 48h. Add screenshots, sample repo link, and 2 test prompts for eval harness.
Maya (Growth): copy checklist: hero headline, 3 bullets on outcomes, small benchmark chart, 2 CTAs, author byline. also want one small community post for OSS channels linking to the tutorial repo.
Jon (DevRel): sample repo: github.com/redwood-inference/hackweek-starter. will open a PR with README + mini examples tonight.
Lina (PMM): webinar format: 25m demo, 15m Q&A, CTA to join a dedicated capacity webinar for infra customers. who can moderate?
Samir (Product): I can moderate the Q&A. Lina — ping me the key objection points to prep answers.
Kai (Analytics): tracking: create 2 segments in GA and lead events in GA4: "guide_started", "benchmark_downloaded", "webinar_rsvp". I'll set dashboards.
Maya (Growth): sounds good. final asks: everyone drop assets to /drive/hackweek-guides by Fri EOD. I'll draft the social snippets once landing copy is done. :rocket:
Jon (DevRel): small note — let's include a one-click colab for the tutorial. lowers friction.
Lina (PMM): agree. also will prepare two headline variations for A/B test on the hero.
Maya (Growth): perfect. thanks all — will follow up with a short PRD and assign tasks.
Samir (Product): +1. quick win: let's ensure the benchmark charts are export-ready (png + csv).
Kai (Analytics): will include CSV export.
Maya (Growth): end-of-thread: if anyone can't meet the deadlines, flag here and we'll re-prioritize. :team-heart:
